children: Citigroup on Friday pushed its forecast for the Federal Reserve's next interest-rate cut to June 2027 from October 2026, citing stronger-than-expected August payroll growth and a labor market that remains broadly stable.

The brokerage had previously forecast 25-basis-point rate cuts in October and December 2026 and January 2027, but now expects the Fed to deliver quarter-point reductions in June, September and December 2027.
